cvEn: Shimon Aizenberg, son of Pesia and Matityahu, was born on 23 Sivan 5690 (19 June 1930) in Paris, the capital of France. His parents were murdered in Europe in 1942, and he, together with his older brother and two sisters, immigrated to the country in 1944. He completed his elementary schooling in France, and in the country he studied at the high school in Givat Brenner. He also studied at the agricultural school in Ben Shemen. He served as deputy work manager at the Tiberias quarry. He was drafted into the IDF in May 1948. He fell in battle at the Jordan River outlet near the Sea of Galilee on 27 Nisan 5711 (3 May 1951), and was laid to rest in the military cemetery in Afula. The local council of Kiryat Motzkin placed a marble plaque bearing his name at the Bayit HaMagen in Heroes' Square there.
